annotations.title: Act under a key you kept

description: Act under a key you kept (from whoami { export: true } in an earlier session, or the SDK’s key file): key { pub, priv } as kept (JSON Web Keys, P-256). The session acts under it from then on; call enter again to go on the wire under it.

key.description: the key pair as it was kept, from whoami { export: true } or the SDK’s key file

addr.description: the key’s address in the city (optional: the door works it out from the public key)

priv.description: the private key, a JSON Web Key on P-256; it is held in this session’s memory and written nowhere

pub.description: the public key, a JSON Web Key on P-256

name: use_key
title: Act under a key you kept
